run_pipeline_text2world: run the Cosmos2_5_PredictBasePipeline to generate a world video from a text prompt
run_pipeline_image2world: run the Cosmos2_5_PredictBasePipeline to generate a world video conditioned on a single image
run_pipeline_video2world: run the Cosmos2_5_PredictBasePipeline to predict a world video conditioned on an input video clip
encode_prompt_text: encode a text prompt into hidden state embeddings using the Qwen2_5 VL text encoder
prepare_latents_video: prepare noisy latents and conditioning latents for video-to-world diffusion generation
